query:
SELECT id, card_id, grade, price, currency, jpy_price, sold_at, source
FROM priceHistory
WHERE grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
  AND CAST(price AS DECIMAL) < 2000
ORDER BY sold_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
